request.style: English, male soul voice, warm and grounded, solo with subtle choir harmonies, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, saxophone, gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Shem rose after the flood
Elam and Asshur stood in the wood
Arpachshad led his children along
Shelah and Eber carried the song

Eber had two sons in that day
Peleg when earth was divided away
His brother Joktan took the east
Settling the lands from north to the least

[Chorus]
From Mesha toward Sephar we go
Hill country of the east, steady and slow
Hadoram and Uzal walk beside
Diklah and Obal sharing the tide

[Verse]
Abimael and Sheba follow in line
Ophir and Havilah crossed the design
Jobab stands firm with the sons of the land
Thirteen names written across the land

All these were the sons of Joktan
Settled in the eastern mountain plain
Chronicled again in the scroll
Confirming the line as faithful and whole

[Chorus]
From Mesha toward Sephar we go
Hill country of the east, steady and slow
Hadoram and Uzal walk beside
Diklah and Obal sharing the tide

[Bridge]
Ezekiel speaks of the trade of Tyre
Vedan and Javan from Uzal by
Wrought iron and cassia in hand
Cane in the market, a foreign land

[Outro]
From Mesha toward Sephar we go
Hill country of the east, steady and slow
